title: Residual-dimension obstructions for null-projected supersymmetric Yang-Mills theories — submission package
description:
Residual-dimension obstructions for null-projected supersymmetric Yang-Mills theories. Version 1.6.0 corrects four statements in Section 7 of the detailed third version (the opening of Section 7 no longer says translations can arise only from null contractions; Proposition 7.1 assumes a nonzero coupling, states its conditions for all gaugino values allowed by the constraint and all parameters, and treats rank zero separately), after an independent review; the theorems and the conclusion of Proposition 7.1 are unchanged. The folder hexagon-v3 holds the detailed third version of the Hexagon preprint (NullProjectedSYM_v3.pdf, 26 pages, its TeX ZIP with the Python programs in anc/, unpacked source, arXiv tarball, Hexagon portal fields and AI provenance file). Section 7.1 quotes the proposal of Rios, Marrani and Chester to repeat Nishino's proof in the signatures (11+8n)+3, writes out Nishino's equations, and proves in Proposition 7.1 that the repetition fails for every rank of a real null frame: at most three null vectors against Nishino's ten in 27+3, only rank two compatible with the translation bracket, and at rank two the residual spinors have 4096 components where absorption of the cubic gaugino terms needs 48. Appendix D and the program transfer_check.py check each step in explicit gamma matrices (24 checks). Remark 7.3 states what the five axioms do and do not decide.

The paper proves necessary residual-dimension and signature conditions for null-projected supersymmetric Yang-Mills constructions under five explicit axioms, and a separate unitary helicity-span obstruction. It does not assert existence in every allowed signature or a nonperturbative quantum construction, and it does not decide theories outside the five axioms.

Verification scope: No general Lean formalisation is claimed. The proofs are written in the manuscript; the gamma-matrix calculations are supplementary finite numerical checks.

Earlier preprint versions: https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00471v1 and https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00471v2. Second-version package DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23672585; first v3 package DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23744131; version 1.5.0 DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23744833.
